Philippines: Typhoon Uwan (Fung-wong) is forecasted to bring strong winds and heavy rainfall to several regions in the coming days. Current projections show the storm hitting central or northern Luzon by early morning Nov. 10 as a level five typhoon with winds exceeding 115 mph.  
This is a life-threatening storm.  
High winds may damage structures and cause widespread electrical outages - leaving some areas without electricity or basic services.  U.S. citizens should follow local guidance, including evacuation orders.  Those who choose to remain in the storm’s path should prepare for life-threatening winds and flooding and stockpile food, water, and medication.
Storm tracking and updates at: https://t.co/zG5LW1NsJC
More: https://t.co/ohEWflumMc

🌍 Global Security Outlook – 07 Nov 2025

AFRICA
🇸🇴 Somalia – EU naval force racing to Malta-flagged tanker seized by pirates; second approach reported.
🇸🇩 Sudan – RSF says it accepts a U.S.-led Quad proposal for a humanitarian truce.
🇹🇿 Tanzania – Kenya urges protection for its citizens amid post-election unrest.
🇳🇬 Nigeria – U.S. Embassy warns of holiday-season spikes in robberies, carjackings, and kidnappings.

EAST ASIA & PACIFIC
🇵🇭 🇻🇳 🇰🇭 Philippines/Vietnam/Cambodia – Typhoon Kalmaegi death toll reaches 193 as storm tracks toward Cambodia.
🇮🇩 Indonesia – Mosque blast at a Jakarta high school injures 54 during Friday prayers.

EUROPE
🇧🇪 Belgium – Drone sightings briefly halt flights at a major European cargo airport.
🇸🇪 Sweden – Traffic resuming at Sweden’s #2 airport after drone scare; sabotage probe noted.

MIDDLE EAST & NORTH AFRICA
🇱🇧 🇮🇱 Lebanon/Israel – IDF says strikes on Hizbollah targets in south Lebanon have concluded; UN peacekeepers condemned recent escalation.
🇸🇾 Syria – UN Security Council votes to lift sanctions on President Ahmad Al-Sharaa.

SOUTH & CENTRAL ASIA
🇮🇳 India – ATC messaging glitch delays 200+ flights at Delhi airport.
🇵🇰 Pakistan – Protests in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa over alleged army shelling of homes and mosques.

WESTERN HEMISPHERE
🇦🇷 Argentina – “Bribe Books” mega-corruption case enters public trial with high-profile defendants.
🇧🇴 Bolivia – President-elect Rodrigo Paz to be sworn in amid empty reserves and fractured congress.
🇲🇽 Mexico – Popular mayor assassinated by teen gunman; authorities cite organized-crime involvement.
🇲🇽 🇵🇪 Mexico/Peru – Peru declares Mexico’s president persona non grata over asylum for ex-PM Betssy Chávez.
🇧🇷 Brazil – Rio’s André Rebouças Tunnel closed after bus electrical fire, disrupting traffic.
